atlas_getting-started.title: Getting started
atlas_getting-started.summary: Four steps through navigation, help and the command menu.

1.title: Welcome to Atlas
1.body: This tour shows where things are. You can end it at any time and replay it from Help.

2.title: Navigation
2.body: Everything you can open is in the sidebar. Groups that match your role start expanded.

3.title: Help on every page
3.body: Press ? or choose Help for the articles, shortcuts and support for the page you are on.

4.title: The command menu
4.body: Press Mod+K or / and type the name of any page to go there.

module_collections.title: Working with collections
module_collections.summary: Views, filters and saved views in three steps.

1.title: One collection, many views
1.body: Each collection offers only the views that fit its data: list, table, board, calendar or map.

2.title: Switch views
2.body: Use the view switcher. Your filters, sort and search stay as they are.

3.title: Save a view
3.body: Open Saved views to save what you see, share it with a team, or open it by default.

module_crew.title: Crew and time
module_crew.summary: Shifts, timesheets and payroll in three steps.

1.title: The resource schedule
1.body: Shifts show people down the side and time across. Publish shifts so crew can accept them in Compass.

2.title: Time from Compass
2.body: Crew clock in inside the venue geofence. Supervisors approve timesheets; later changes void the approval.

3.title: Payroll
3.body: Export payroll for a pay period and post it. A posted period stays closed.

gates.title: Gates guard each phase
gates.body: A gate passes only when its blocking criteria are met. Hover over a gate chip for its definition.

access-grid.title: Change access cell by cell
access-grid.body: Move with the arrow keys and press Space to allow or deny a category in a zone.

resource-schedule.title: Read the resource schedule
resource-schedule.body: People run down the side and time runs across. Switch to the table view for the same shifts as rows.

saved-views.title: Save the view you need
saved-views.body: Set your filters, then open Saved views to keep them, share them or open them by default.

reconciliation.title: Gaps feed the next gate
reconciliation.body: A rider requirement the venue cannot meet, or one marked UNKNOWN on a critical item, shows as a gate gap.
